decision_cruda.rationale: LH-02 is down at E569-07, confirmed by radio and CMMS. The likely repair is 13:30, so the stope would sit idle. LH-10 is idle at the workshop, has no home place, and is 0.49 h away. At 27.5 t/h it clears the 164 t (about 55 oz at 10.5 g/t) in about 6 h, which fits before 17:00. Este's trucks (72 t/h) are unconstrained and its stockpile is nearly empty. Nothing is taken from a producing place or from development. A reserve activation isn't allowed, because no stope has stopped.

LH-10 stays on E569-07 (158 t at 10.5 g, covers LH-02's failure). Move LH-08 from the cheap preparation heading (1.3 oz/h) to C564-14 (317 t at 10.7 g, 0.33 h away). It loads about 25 t/h for roughly 6.5 h, which is about 57 oz of ore against about 9 oz of development lost. I left LH-09 on the critical-path heading (4.2 oz/h), because a second loader would add about 50 oz and cost about 29 oz while risking a full Central stockpile. Repairs are expected at 12:30–14:30, so I plan on no repaired loader contributing early. Radio and CMMS agree on both failures, so no confirmation is needed.

Keep LH-08 on C564-14 (312t at 10.7 g) and LH-10 on E569-07 (10.5 g), which cover the failed LH-01 and LH-02. Move LH-07 from N548-08 (157t at 5.8 g, about 29 oz) to N600-11 (210t at 9.1 g, about 61 oz) for a 0.37 h trip. It runs faster there (29.1 vs 23.6 t/h). Norte is near truck-limited, but this swaps one loader for another, so inflow stays about the same. I did not take LH-09 because it is on the critical-path heading (4.2 oz/h). I did not activate a reserve because no stope was stopped. All three failures are confirmed by both radio and CMMS, so there is no CONFIRM-01 conflict.
